display_name: Toy Store: Tidy Up Sorting Sim
display_long_description:
Toy Store: Tidy Up Sorting Sim 🧸

Welcome to Toy Store: Tidy Up Sorting Sim, a cozy and satisfying game where your job is simple: sort toys, organize shelves, and keep your toy store looking perfect!

Step into a colorful toy shop filled with adorable plushies, rubber ducks, dolls, action figures, and all kinds of toys waiting to be organized.

Whether you love sorting games, tidy-up simulators, or simply enjoy putting everything in its perfect place, this relaxing experience is made for you!

🧸 Sort, Organize & Tidy Up!

Your toy store is full of toys, but the shelves aren't going to organize themselves!

Pick up toys, sort them into their correct places, and transform messy shelves into beautifully organized displays. Every toy has its place, and it's up to you to find it!

🦆 Sort Them Ducks!

Rubber ducks, teddy bears, dolls, and colorful toys are scattered throughout your shop.

Arrange them neatly, group similar toys together, and enjoy the satisfaction of turning clutter into order.

From tiny ducks to adorable stuffed animals, there's always something that needs sorting!

🧹 A Cozy & Relaxing Sorting Experience

Forget stressful deadlines and complicated tasks. Take your time, enjoy the peaceful atmosphere, and experience the simple joy of tidying up.

Inspired by the satisfying feeling of organizing, cleaning, and sorting, Toy Store: Tidy Up Sorting Sim offers a relaxing escape for anyone who loves cozy games and become the ultimate dressmaker.
